title: One at a time
summary: A rust-coloured steel bridge in Molenhoek with a width limit: one car at a time, and only if it fits.
content:
A rust-coloured steel bridge in Molenhoek, on the border between Limburg and Gelderland. It has a width limit and room for one car at a time, and plenty of drivers have found out the hard way that the limit means it.

Sony RX10 V · f/8 · 1/15 s · ISO 100
